description: S45 T12 (PM15/PM16): policy.get answers the whole row WITH its provenance. `origin` sits beside createdAt — 'system' here, because this row was written by the declared policy.corpus set through the seed door (AddInTx names it; the plain Add's rows carry 'user' from the column's default). The detail read is where provenance belongs stated in full: a person reading one rule should be able to see who authored it AND where it came from without a second call. Absence of the field means a rendering daemon that predates S45 T12, never a row with no provenance — the same additive meaning createdAt and describe carry.
